dateAssessment: Working date: 15 April 1748, from compatible session YAML; only the year 1748 is independently spoken. Twilight plus about an hour supports dusk continuing into night without a date boundary. The opening short rest was already complete. The party’s 5881 dwarven year and Hralgar’s claimed 5031 are retained as differing reckonings; the apparent mountain daylight does not establish time travel or a civil watch.

watches.summary: Twilight opening; roughly an hour of tower investigation, including meditation. The continuous conversation returns to the night sky.
Apparent daylight and Hralgar’s claimed year 5031 belong to the illusion; neither supplies elapsed adventure days or a civil watch.
